notes: Research article (Int. J. Hydrogen Energy 34 (2009) 6314-6319); record.json is_retracted false and no retraction notice in the PDF. Tables 1 and 2 give 77 K, 60 bar excess H2 uptake (Sieverts) with BET SSA for TiC-, Mo2C- and SiC-derived CDCs; Fig. 5 gives isotherms at 33-300 K. The paper says its pore size distributions resemble earlier reports [11-14] and that CO2-activated CDCs are described in [20], but it does not state that its H2 uptake values were published before, so duplicate_data does not apply. No supplementary files were provided.
